context:
The geomean_ms field will exist in the manifest after explorer-extend-manifest-
and-pipeline lands. This TODO is a UI-layer change: swap the field used for
sorting, update column labels, and add a metric definition. No new data
fetching or computation needed.

Tooltip copy: "Geometric mean of per-query execution times (measurement
runs only). More comparable than wall-clock total when query counts differ."
description:
Post-launch audit (2026-04-14) found a metric discrepancy: the CLI uses
geometric mean of per-query times as the primary comparison metric; the
explorer uses total_duration_s (wall-clock sum). These produce different
numbers for the same result, and two results with different query counts
(e.g., full TPC-H vs a query subset) produce incomparable totals.

This TODO:
  1. Makes geomean_ms the primary sort/compare axis in the Compare view,
     Browse tables, and any cohort summary
  2. Relabels total_duration_s wherever it appears so readers know what
     they are looking at
  3. Adds a clear metric definition in the UI (tooltip or footnote)

Prerequisite: explorer-extend-manifest-and-pipeline must land first
(geomean_ms must exist in the manifest before this TODO can consume it).

anti_patterns.why: it is precomputed in the manifest
that hides the metric choice from the reader

preserves.behavior: All data loading logic - this is display/labeling changes only
Existing URL/query-param format for compare view
Null-safety: if geomean_ms is null (e.g., old bundle), fall back to total_duration_s display with a 'N/A' geomean
total_duration_s remains visible - it is honest wall-clock data; just secondary

scope_rules.path_glob: benchbox/core/explorer_pipeline/ (pipeline changes are in the prerequisite TODO)

verifications.expected: at least one sort reference to geomean_ms

verifications.description: total_duration_s is still visible but labeled

work_units.summary: Update Compare.tsx: use geomean_ms as primary sort/compare axis. Keep total_duration_s as secondary column labeled 'Wall-clock total'.
Update BenchmarkIndex.tsx and PlatformIndex.tsx browse tables: sort default by geomean_ms ascending. Relabel 'Duration' column to 'Geomean (ms)' with a tooltip explaining the metric.
Update ResultDetail.tsx summary section: show geomean_ms as 'Geomean query time' prominently; move total_duration_s to secondary metadata row with label 'Total wall-clock'.
Add metric definition tooltip or footnote: 'Geometric mean of per-query execution times (measurement runs only). Lower is faster. Comparable across runs with different query counts.'
